desc: Enumerate all valid states: vectors d[0..N] with d[0]=0, d nondecreasing, increments in {0,1} — equivalent to all 2^N bitmasks.
Design transition: for each mask and letter c, compute next mask via new[j] = max(old[j], new[j-1], old[j-1] + (c == S[j-1])).
Design counting DP: cnt[0]=1, M iterations over 26 letters, mod 998244353; aggregate by popcount(mask) = k.
Implement solve() in Python: read N, M, S from stdin; build trans table; run DP; print answers space-separated.
Verify correctness: sum of answers == 26^M mod p; sample 1 (576 99 1, sum 676 = 26^2) and sample 2 (390625 62500 3750 101, sum 456976 = 26^4, k=0 = 25^4) both consistent.
